preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must have BNB balance from accumulated fees

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call clearStuckBalance(100) to drain 100% of the BNB accumulated in the contract from fees. This function transfers a percentage of the contract's BNB balance directly to the owner without any restrictions. The owner can also abuse other privileged functions like setFeeReceivers to redirect fee distributions to their own addresses, or use multiTransfer to arbitrarily transfer tokens from any address they control.
